title: Implement the authorization decision service
summary: Implemented an immutable authorization request/resource contract, explainable fail-closed decision engine with scoped direct/team provenance, owner-only protections, immediate privilege-change visibility, bounded high-risk denial audit events, and reusable controller/view/job/domain policy adapters while keeping RBAC independent from plans, entitlements, quotas and billing.

tests.notes: 12 checks, 396 Ruby files, zero style offenses, zero Brakeman warnings, zero advisory findings

risks: No decision cache is used by design
trading several bounded indexed lookups per decision for immediate cross-process privilege visibility; prompt 115 may optimize only with revision-safe invalidation.
next_steps: Prompt 032 applies the policy adapter across controllers
